body.statement: For every finite \(G\), the capsule assignment can be sampled in polynomial time, and finite enumeration of all capped reservoir draws and remaining fair coins computes every \(\pi_u\), every entry of \(\Gamma_G\), and every conditional weight defining \(\widehat\tau_G\) exactly; hence the design--estimator pair is total and evaluable without observing internal focal metadata.
body.justification: The information-theoretic theorem must correspond to a finite experiment and an estimator measurable in the published data regime.
body.gap: The prior seed construction required an explicit Rao--Blackwell enumeration audit; the balanced capsule changes both the latent support and the conditional weights.
body.consumer: Exact small-instance evaluation provides a reproducible audit and a benchmark for scalable approximations.
